RDS MySQL/MariaDB logs

These charts refer to the RDS MySQL/MariaDB logs. RDS MySQL's and MariaDB's error logs are generated by default. You can generate the slow query and general logs by setting parameters in your DB parameter group. To set the parameter for MySQL see this AWS documentation and for MariaDB see this AWS documentation and to configure the logs on Splunk Enterprise/Cloud follow this Splunk Add-on for AWS documentation. For more information on sending logs to Splunk Log Observer Connect, see Log Observer Connect documentation.

chart.name: Server error logs
chart.programText: logs(filter=field('source') == '*:/aws/rds/*/error:*').publish()
